<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">external inputs pink / forward logits purple / caller threshold gray / Sigmoid green</tspan>
<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">lengths enter packing through a side port; recurrent weights are shared across time</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="762" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">E### = source span (hover a module); dashed = named state / auxiliary input; fork-join = tuple/list, not sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="817" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
